messages.entry.description.Warrior: A resilient melee fighter. Build Attack, Accuracy and Attack Speed to master powerful sword techniques.
messages.entry.description.Wizard: Wield fire, lightning and ice to strike groups from afar. Build Magic and Casting Speed; keep your distance and watch your MP.
messages.entry.description.Taoist: Summon allies, poison foes and heal wounds. Build Taoism to strengthen your summons and support spells for longer battles.

messages.novice.title: Next step
messages.novice.accept: Accept this quest first. Use the button below to walk to the quest giver.
messages.novice.turnIn: Objective complete! Return to collect your reward.
messages.novice.unlock: Turn in First Steps after defeating 5 Hens to receive your first class skill book and potions. Open your bag and double-click the book to learn.
messages.novice.passive: Fencing learned. It improves your normal attacks automatically.
messages.novice.skill: Learned {{skill}}: use {{key}}. Drink a potion when health or mana is low.
messages.novice.controls: Click to move / attack · 1 health potion · B bag · Q quests
messages.novice.blessing: Maomao’s Blessing is in your bag. Press B and double-click it to equip and activate its bonuses.
messages.novice.quest.201: Click a monster to attack. Defeat 5 chickens, then follow the prompt back to turn in the quest.
messages.novice.quest.202: Accept the visit from the Novice Guide, then turn it in to the Butcher to continue gathering provisions.
messages.novice.quest.203: Pick up the venison after hunting deer. Move near the drop and press F, or click it. You need 5 pieces.
messages.novice.quest.204: Defeat 10 Scarecrows, Hooking Cats or Raking Cats in total. You do not need 10 of each.
messages.novice.quest.205: The boards go into your quest bag when you accept. Visit the Boatman to deliver them, then find the Peddler.
messages.novice.quest.208: Defeat Omas and press F to pick up Longyang Grass. Turn it in to the Peddler for a Town Scroll; keep it for your return from the tomb.
messages.novice.quest.207: Use the village or Bichon station to teleport near the tomb entrance, then enter Floor 1. Defeat a scorpion, pick up its tail and bring it to the Peddler.
messages.novice.useReturn: Use Town Scroll to return to your home town
messages.novice.viaStation: Travel to the tomb entrance via {{npc}}
messages.novice.returnReady: You have a Town Scroll. Use it once you have the tail, or press B and double-click it. It returns you to your home town.
messages.novice.buyReturn: No Town Scroll? Buy one from the village Peddler before leaving. If already in the tomb, you can walk back through the entrance.
messages.novice.buyReturnButton: Visit the Peddler for a Town Scroll
messages.novice.bookReady: Your skill book is in the bag. Press B and double-click it to learn. On mobile, tap for details and double-tap to learn.
